meeting.title: Working session
meeting.summary: Technical working session on the staging model refactor. Agreed to split the oversized staging model into three sources before defining any measures on top of it. The customer engineer will open the refactor PR by Tuesday; the vendor engineer will review it within a day of it landing.
action_items: Open the staging model refactor PR by Tuesday
Review the refactor PR within one day of it landing
key_decisions: Split stg_events into three source-aligned staging models before building measures on top
meeting.notes: The single staging model currently unions three unrelated sources, which is why compile times ballooned.

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: So, the thing we parked last week: stg_events. It unions three unrelated sources and it's slowing everything down.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Yeah, it's a mess. It predates me — someone bolted the webhook feed and the app database onto the same model.

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: The clean fix is three staging models, one per source, and a thin union on top only where you genuinely need all three.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: That matches what I sketched. My worry is the downstream refs — about a dozen models select from stg_events directly.

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: Keep stg_events as the union view for now, so downstream refs don't break, and migrate them one by one afterwards.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Okay, that de-risks it. Let me say it back: three new staging models, stg_events becomes a thin union, downstream untouched for now.

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: Exactly. And I'd hold off defining any measures on top until the refactor lands, otherwise we're building on sand.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Agreed, measures wait. I can get the refactor PR open by Tuesday — it's mostly mechanical once the pattern is set.

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: Tuesday's good. Tag me on it and I'll review the PR within a day of it landing so you're not blocked on us.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Deal. One more thing — do you want the compile-time numbers before and after? Might be a nice proof point.

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: If it's cheap to grab, sure, but don't burn time on it. The refactor is the priority.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Understood. PR by Tuesday, then it's on you.

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: On me. Good session — this unblocks the whole modeling phase.
